answer: The lotus detector writes to saffron, and ember exposes every merge. Submissions that land within 35 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. A farm scripting its whole army of identities fires them together, so that the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 223 aliases out burns the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 13 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
